login.title: Sign in to the club
login.subtitle: Owner, reception and coach only. Players use the mobile app.
login.playerBlocked: This desk is for staff. Open the app on your phone.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: This club only. No national ranking.
dashboard.noMoney: Revenue, wallets and lessons come later — this is not a national circuit.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.lead: Courts as columns, time on the left. Click an empty slot to book.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.lead: Today’s list. Type is full or missing 1 / 2.

players.title: Players
players.lead: This club’s directory. Club level, not a national tour.
players.name: Name
players.genderRequired: Set a gender. Without it they cannot enter a tournament category.

tournaments.title: Club tournaments
tournaments.lead: Events in this club. No national championship.
tournaments.name: Name
tournaments.deskLead: Reception runs the tournament here: entries, rounds, scores. The phone app is for the player.
tournaments.whoFits: Players do not have a category on their profile. This draw only takes people who match the rules.

eligibility.gender_missing: {{name}}: gender is missing on the profile. «{{category}}» accepts {{need}}.
eligibility.age_missing: {{name}}: birth year is missing. «{{category}}» accepts ages {{ages}}.

tournaments.entriesLocked: A score is in. Players cannot be changed.
tournaments.swapHint: To swap before a score: remove one, add another. An unscored round is cleared — press New round again.
tournaments.rotateHint: With 5+ players one sits out. On the next round you choose which pair they join.
tournaments.rotatePick: {{name}} comes in. Pick a pair — tap who sits out.
tournaments.waitScore: Enter the score before opening the next round.
tournaments.noRoundCap: There is no round limit. When time is up, close that match — not the whole tournament.
tournaments.closeWhich: If more than one match is on, close the one that stopped.

courts.title: Courts
courts.lead: Indoor / outdoor is the roof type, not whether the court accepts bookings.
courts.kindHint: Construction type. Indoor = covered. It does not mean the court is closed for play.
